items.title: 1.5.3 Using UML to Represent Software Systems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of using UML (PDF 24-25).

blocks.text: UML software development ki mukhtalif stages mein samajh aur baat cheet (communication) behtar karne ke liye istemal ho sakti hai. Is ke kuch amli istemal yeh hain:

items: Planning: code likhne se pehle UML diagrams se system ki requirements aur design ka naqsha banana.
Development: developers system ki banawat (structure) aur us ke hisson ke rishte samajhne ke liye UML diagrams dekhte hain.
Communication: UML diagrams team ke logon ko, un ko bhi jo technical nahi (non-technical stakeholders), samjhate hain ke system kaise kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Coding se pehle UML ka ek istemal aur development ke dauran ek istemal likhein.
blocks.explanation: Coding se pehle: requirements aur design ka naqsha banana. Development ke dauran: developers system ki banawat aur rishte samajhne ke liye diagrams dekhte hain.

items: UML ke istemal: planning (code se pehle requirements aur design), development (banawat aur rishte), communication (non-technical log bhi samjhein).
